messages:
Incident Bot: ALERT: Elevated 502/504 rates detected at edge gateway cluster - automatic paging sent. Severity: high. Primary: @priya_r.

Priya R: I'm here. dashboards show a sharp 5xx spike starting 2026-03-15T18:05Z, peaking ~15% errors on /v1/chat and /v1/generate. Affected regions: us-east-1 and eu-west-1.

Priya R: any deploys or routing flips in the last hour?

Devon H: there was a traffic-shaper rollout 70m ago to smooth bursty clients (feature flag `burst-mitigation=v2`). rolled to 50% only.

Kai L: pulling edge proxy traces now. I'm seeing many `upstream close` and `protocol error` lines from edge->gateway with HTTP/2 GOAWAYs. sample:
```
[2026-03-15T18:06:07Z] edge-proxy-12: upstream=10.9.12.8:443 code=502 proto=HTTP/2 msg="stream reset/GOAWAY"
[2026-03-15T18:06:07Z] edge-proxy-12: upstream=10.9.12.9:443 code=504 msg="upstream read timeout"
```

Marta S: CS reporting BrightStream webhook consumers saw large percent failures. tagging P1 and notifying customer ops.

Customer Success - Priam: BrightStream reports client sdk errors and exponential retries, they want interim mitigation now.

Priya R: initial hypothesis: traffic-shaper change interacts badly with HTTP/2 multiplexing causing head-of-line blocking + backend overload, combined with client retries -> connection storm. Plan: 1) disable traffic-shaper feature flag 2) temporarily disable HTTP/2 on edge->gateway to force HTTP/1.1 keepalive 3) add circuit breaker at edge for /v1/* returning 429 after short drop 4) spin up standby dedicated-gateway pool for overflow 5) customer comms.

Devon H: reverting traffic-shaper flag now: `ffctl set burst-mitigation=v1 --env=prod`.

OpsBot: feature flag change executed by Devon H.

Kai L: disabling HTTP/2 on edge->gateway (non-PII routes) using config set `proxy.http2=false` on prod-edge-configmap. applying..

SRE Bot: notice: config roll detected across edge-proxy DaemonSet.

Priya R: enabling short-circuit circuit breaker: `edge-router:cb_threshold=7, cb_window=10s, cb_action=429` for /v1/generate and /v1/chat.

Kai L: circuit breaker in place. immediate effect: client-side retries reduced, observed drop in concurrent backend streams. error rate falling from 15% -> 4% in 2 minutes.

Devon H: standing up dedicated-gateway pool `dedicated-gw-standby` (4 nodes) and registering with traffic-router. command: `k8s scale deployment/dedicated-gateway-standby --replicas=4`.

Marta S: routing rule activated to overflow traffic to standby when backend latency > 300ms.

Priya R: customer impact: BrightStream partial recovery; they're seeing ~10% failure now vs 40% earlier. sending interim note.

Customer Success - Priam: relaying to BrightStream: "We've applied mitigations (disabled traffic-shaper, disabled HTTP/2 multiplexing for edge->gateway, enabled circuit breaker and overflow pool). We're monitoring and will share RCA."

Kai L: digging into kernel metrics on gateway nodes - conntrack entries spiked, and ephemeral sockets in TIME_WAIT are high. looks like we hit conntrack limit on a subset of NAT boxes which triggered resets.

Devon H: increasing conntrack and tcp keepalive on nat-gw set: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` and `sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout=30`. applying to nat-gw pool.

OpsBot: sysctl changes executed by Devon H.

Kai L: after disabling HTTP/2 and circuit breaker, backend 502/504s decreased to ~1.2% across regions. standby pool absorbing bursts.

Priya R: handoff: I need to brief execs with CS. @kai_l can you own the incident for the next 90 mins and drive RCA? I'll join the postmortem.

Kai L: taking over. current state: mitigations in place (traffic-shaper rollback, HTTP/2 disabled for edge->gateway, circuit breakers, standby pool, conntrack tuning). monitoring for 60-90m.

Marta S: follow-ups to track: revert HTTP/2 disable only after thorough testing; add canary for traffic-shaper that simulates HTTP/2 multiplexing; add connection-saturation alerts; add per-customer retry budget enforcement. I'll own routing/flag cleanup.

Priya R: please also add a playbook entry for "edge-http2-backend-surge" with step-by-step mitigations we just performed.

SRE Bot: incident timeline saved. creating follow-up ticket INC-2026-521. Owners: Devon H (nat & infra tuning), Marta S (routing & flags), Kai L (RCA lead), Priya R (customer comms).

Kai L: scheduling RCA doc + postmortem meeting tomorrow 14:00 UTC. I'll produce an initial timeline and attach logs.

Priya R: thanks team. quick thumbs up everyone. :thumbsup:

Customer Success - Priam: BrightStream acknowledging mitigations; they'll wait for RCA. thanks for the fast action.

SRE Bot: on-call handoff: new owner Kai L, previous owner Priya R.

Incident Bot: incident moved to monitoring-only.

Kai L: closing active mitigation channel; will keep monitoring slack thread open for updates.
